content:
“Good thing you're up to date on all 2316 vaccines!”

**Vaccinated** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

It is exclusive to human players and cannot be equipped by ghoul players.

| 1 | +2 | 
| 15 | +40 | 
| 30 | +70 | 
| 60 | +90 | 
| 98 | +99 | 

Increases Disease Resistance based on current Endurance.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Increased Disease Resistance based on END. | 00323F91 | 

Before Update 56, Vaccinated had 3 ranks and reduced chance of disease from creatures by 30%/60%/90%.

Other perks that scale with Endurance include:

- Adamantium Skeleton - Less limb damage
- Iron Stomach - Bonus damage and energy resistance
- Lead Belly - Less radiation from eating and drinking
- LifeGiver - Bonus HP
- Natural Resistance - Bonus elemental resistance
- Rad Resistant - Bonus radiation resistance
- Thirst Quencher - More AP
